fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential processes activity of Network Monitor for Employees RMM tool
fields.name: Potential Network Monitor for Employees RMM Tool Process Activity
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path contains "\\nmep_agtconfig.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\nmep_ctrlagent.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\nmep_ctrlagentsvc.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\winpty-agent.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\winpty-agent64.exe") or (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\nmep_agtconfig.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\nmep_ctrlagent.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\nmep_ctrlagentsvc.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\winpty-agent.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\winpty-agent64.exe")))
